rationale: Damage to the claimant's own kitchen property (charred cabinets, smoke damage to ceiling and walls) caused by an accidental grease fire, with no other party involved.
claim_summary: Claim filed by Alex Doe (POL-1001) for kitchen fire damage. Active homeowners policy covers property damage with $500 deductible and $250,000 limit. Incident: grease flare-up on stove yesterday evening. Claimant extinguished fire with fire extinguisher. Damage: charred cabinets above stove, smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Localized damage, medium severity.

case_facts.description: grease flare-up on stove; claimant extinguished with fire extinguisher
case_facts.damage_type: charred kitchen cabinets above stove; smoke damage on ceiling and walls

rationale: Wind damage to the claimant's own roof shingles with no third-party involvement is clear property damage to their own home.
claim_summary: Claim for Jordan Lee, POL-1006 (homeowners_premium, active). Wind damage to back porch overhang: four shingles blown off by wind last weekend with no interior water damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Deductible $2,500, coverage limit $1M. Classified as low-severity property damage due to minor damage amount and no injuries or secondary damage.

case_facts.damage_description: four shingles blown off, no interior water damage
